name: AiXiangJi
source:
LoveAlbum is a story-driven romantic visual novel.

Six girls. Six completely unique, heart-fluttering stories.
When the story comes to an end, the traces of your journey will be preserved in a single album.
Here—every shared glance, racing heartbeat, and choice you make will become a cherished memory you can look back on again and again.

In this world, ordinary humans aren't the only ones around... there are also people with animal features living among us. Rabbit ears, cat ears, fox ears... a wide variety of demi-humans. Even though demi-humans are quite common, I don't actually have any friends who are one... To me, they still feel a bit mysterious...

But honestly, who could possibly say no to a girl with fluffy ears? ~

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4524270]Steam[/url]]
